meta.name: Ingest-Transform-Validate
meta.description: Data processing pipeline that ingests raw data, classifies it, applies transformations, validates results, and packages output. Features integrity monitoring, transformation fidelity tracking, and validation gates.
meta.author: Hankweave Templates

hank.name: Ingest: Load and inventory source data
hank.description: Read and catalog all source data, establishing baseline integrity metrics

command.run: mkdir -p ingested classified transformed validated output

hank.name: Classify: Categorize and tag data items
hank.description: Analyze ingested data and assign categories, types, and processing tags

hank.name: Transform: Apply transformations to classified data
hank.description: Transform data according to classification, preserving semantic meaning

hank.name: Validate: Verify transformation correctness
hank.description: Comprehensive validation of transformed data against source and schema

validate.message: No transformed data found — transform phase may not have completed

hank.name: Package: Assemble final output
hank.description: Package validated data into the final output format with metadata
